messages.subject: Co-mentor needed: Regularized interval regression
parts:
Hi,

I am looking for a co-mentor for the project on regularized regression with interval censored data.

The project aims at developing the first R package with support for (1) four types of censoring, (2) elastic net regularization, (3) a fast coordinate descent algortithm like glmnet, and (4) accelerated failure time loss functions (log-normal, log-logistic, exponential and weibull).

Dr. Toby Hocking proposed the project, and will be a mentor. He has written a detailed project description at the link given below:
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2016/wiki/Regularized-interval-regression

Hope to find some interested mentors!

Best regards,
Anuj
